entities.name: Jaume Ortí Ruiz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaume Ortí Ruiz was a Spanish businessman who was the president of the football club Valencia CF from 2001 to 2004. His time as president, which mostly overlapped with Rafael Benítez's spell as manager, resulted in more trophies than any other president of the club: La Liga titles in 2002 and 2004, the UEFA Cup in 2004 and the UEFA Super Cup in 2004.
